question: In which of the following animals does the body temperature NOT depend on the temperature in the environment?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Birds and mammals**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
